title: Min Stack
description: Design a stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element, with every operation running in constant time.
inputFormat: Read from standard input exactly in the line-based format shown in the example.
outputFormat: Print only the requested result to standard output.
constraints: All operations and values are valid for the described data structure.

examples.input:
7
push -2
push 0
push -3
getMin
pop
top
getMin
examples.explanation: The minimum is tracked in constant time after every operation.

title: Next Greater Element II
description: Given a circular integer array nums, return the next greater value for every element. The next greater value is the first strictly greater value encountered while moving right, wrapping from the end of the array to the beginning. Return -1 when no greater value exists.
inputFormat: First line: integer n, the number of elements
outputFormat: Print n space-separated integers containing the next greater value for each element.

examples.explanation: The next greater value for the first 1 is 2. No value is greater than 2. For the last 1, wrapping around reaches 2.
